newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZAMBIA BREWERIES IN STRONG DEBUT ON LUSAKA BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: ZAMBIA BREWERIES IN STRONG DEBUT ON LUSAKA BOURSE.

text.p: Zambian Breweries, which made its debut on the Lusaka Stock Exchange (LuSE) on Monday, immediately leapt 33.3 percent on its initial offer price, exchange officials said.
Zambia Breweries stock jumped to 200 kwacha -- a gain of 50 kwacha on the Zambia Privatisation Trust Fund's offer price to investors.
"Clearly this demonstrates that the shares were attractively priced and made affordable for broad participation," an exchange official said.
The initial public offering of 13 million shares attracted 1,825 first-time investors and was 1.6 times oversubscribed.
"(Zambia Breweries) brings strength and diversity to the LuSE market and the investment opportunities available both to domestic and international investors," the official said.

Zamangola Industrial Corp Ltd, a subsidiary of Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd and Indol International BV, a wholly-owned subsidiary of South African Breweries Ltd , each have a 45 percent stake in the firm.
The brewer is the seventh company to list on the three-year- old exchange.
